subject: [PATCH v3 11/18] selftests/mm: parameterize the mixed-source collapse case by source order

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c test to parameterize the mixed-source collapse case by source order. The test now takes two new command-line options, -s and -c, which specify the source order and target order respectively. The test faults at the specified source order if it is supported, or at order 2 otherwise. This allows for more flexible testing of memory allocation scenarios.
